title: Lab - Manage software, repositories and build from source
description: Install a package, add a repo, and build a tool from source.
scenario: Install a package, add a repo, and build a tool from source. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Package
tasks.instructions: Install tree and find which package owns /usr/bin/tree.
tasks.solution: apt install -y tree; dpkg -S /usr/bin/tree  # dnf install tree; rpm -qf /usr/bin/tree

tasks.title: Task 2 - Repository
tasks.instructions: Add the official Docker repository (with its GPG key) and install docker-ce.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Source
tasks.instructions: Download a small GNU tool tarball, configure, build and install it under /usr/local.
tasks.solution: tar xzf hello-2.12.tar.gz && cd hello-2.12 && ./configure && make && make install
